ns2:course.label: Special Study & Investigation
ns2:course.description: Offers opportunity for an individual to study, on or off campus, selected problems, trends, and new developments or to conduct specialized investigations for the improvement of instructional programs in areas related to education and training. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours.
